title: SIXSENSE  auto join auto play auto webhook
features:
sixsense — Last Letter Script (v1.0.0)

Overview:
Sixsense is a comprehensive helper for Last Letter that combines automation (auto-join, auto-answer, auto claim tasks), cash, skill, winstreak revealer, camera preview, answer statistics, and Integrated Discord Webhook Notifications — all features can be access via configurable UI.

---

Main Features
- Auto Answer — Auto-complete and type answers with configurable delays and retry logic; supports both aggressive and human-like typing modes.
- Smart Word Suggester — Online word database with search, paging, and caching for fast suggestion lookup.
- ESP - Highly configurable visual overlays: player name, distance, health, streaks, executions, spins, table number, box/skeleton/tracers, and range limits.

ESP details:
- name
- skill/style
- win streak
- executions
- cash reveal
- auto spins
- table number

Usage notes:
Use ESP Revealer when you need extra context about players (e.g., hidden health or streaks), but be mindful of possible data availability—some values depend on game attributes or leaderstats and might not exist for every player. If performance becomes an issue, reduce MaxDistance or disable filled/skeleton modes.

Quick tip: set MaxDistance to 200-300, disable skeletons and filled boxes, and enable only the fields you need (name, distance, health); use ESP Revealer only when necessary as it can be heavier.
- Chams — Color tint and outline options with transparency and "visible-only" settings for improved visibility.
- Auto Join — Automatic table joining with filters for table size and game mode; configurable join delays and leave-on-empty behavior.
- Extras Automation — Daily reward claim, auto-spin with target selection, and task automation.
- Camera & Preview — Character viewport preview, chams/skeleton preview, and camera controls (zoom/rotation).
- Discord Webhook — Send notifications on wins/loses/game-end with optional pinging and custom thumbnails.
- Answer History & Stats — Track used answers, accuracy, streaks, strikes, and view stats in the UI.

---

Key Highlights
- Human-like Auto Answer: Realistic typing simulation reduces obvious automation signatures.
- Powerful Visuals (ESP & Chams): Deep customization for what to display and how it looks.
- Smart Auto Join: Target the exact table sizes and game modes you want to play.
- Discord Integration: Automated reporting to channels for monitoring or community updates.
